title: Vioverse v1.0 — Moonlit Royal Interface
notes: Major visual redesign across Home, Characters, Expeditions, Discoveries, Gathering, Inventory, Missions, Legacy, Journal, Gacha, Shop and Update Game. New clean illustrated moonlit-forest background, ornate rarity cards, matching typography and responsive panels. Fixed character flip flashing by toggling card faces in place while preserving game progress and five-second update checks.
